findings.title: Off-by-one error in totalPages when user_count is an exact multiple of limit
findings.body: `totalPages` computes `Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1`. When `user_count` is a positive multiple of `limit` (e.g. `user_count = 50` and `limit = 50`), this yields `2` instead of `1`. As a result, the UI shows `1/2`, `showingLast` is false, and clicking "next" sets `offset` to `user_count` (50) and fetches an empty second page (`Math.ceil(user_count / limit)` should be used instead).

findings.title: Admin::GroupsController#create ignores alias_level parameter
findings.body: `Discourse.Group#asJSON` sends `name`, `alias_level`, and `visible` when creating a group via `POST /admin/groups`, and the new group form exposes the `alias_level` combo box before saving. However, `Admin::GroupsController#create` only assigns `group.name` and `group.visible` and never sets `group.alias_level`, so any alias level chosen during group creation is silently discarded.

findings.title: Unbounded and unvalidated limit/offset in GroupsController#members
findings.body: In `GroupsController#members`, `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` are passed directly to ActiveRecord's `.limit(limit).offset(offset)` without bounds checking. A caller can pass an arbitrarily large `limit` to serialize the entire `users` table in one request, or pass negative values for `limit` or `offset` which causes PostgreSQL to raise `ActiveRecord::StatementInvalid` (`LIMIT/OFFSET must not be negative`) resulting in an unhandled 500 error.

findings.title: Adding an already-existing member to a group raises a uniqueness error
findings.body: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, `group.add(user)` is called for each resolved username without checking whether the user is already a member of `group`. `Group#add` appends to `group_users` (`self.group_users.build(...)` / `users << user`), which triggers a `RecordNotUnique` / validation failure on `(group_id, user_id)` if any of the submitted usernames is already in the group.
